Overview

Blockchain & Digital Trust for 3PL & Freight Forwarding earns its budget only when it changes a number on someone's scorecard. So we invert the usual sequence: lock the metric and its baseline first, then work backwards to the smallest architecture that moves it — usually composed from TMS execution and the tower platform rather than built from scratch. In Logistics & Supply Chain the constraints are structural, not cosmetic: GDPR / privacy regimes shapes what data may move, dwell time dominates the economics, and any capability that cannot explain its own decisions will be switched off by risk committees. The architecture reflects all three from the first commit.
